name: Outbound Prospecting & Sales
examples: B2B agency founder, independent consultant, outbound SaaS salesperson
recognise: They primarily find prospects and initiate contact through LinkedIn, cold email, direct messages or phone calls, then manage conversations and follow-ups.

name: Scoped Project Sales
examples: management consultant, freelance copywriter, graphic design studio
recognise: They sell customised, one-time professional projects where scoping, quoting and client approval are the main sales steps.

name: Monthly Retainer Sales
examples: marketing agency, bookkeeping firm, virtual assistant service
recognise: They acquire clients for recurring monthly services and mainly track consultations, proposals and retainer agreements rather than cold outreach.

name: Professional Client Engagements
examples: family lawyer, immigration consultant, tax advisory practice
recognise: They provide regulated or specialised professional services requiring intake, consultation, fee agreements or formal engagement.

name: Custom Software Project Sales
examples: app development studio, website agency, automation consultancy
recognise: They build custom software, websites or integrations where technical requirements and estimates decide the sale.

name: Managed IT Service Contracts
examples: managed IT provider, cybersecurity service company, outsourced IT firm
recognise: They sell recurring technology support or security services after evaluating a client's systems.

name: Corporate Training Bookings
examples: corporate trainer, leadership workshop provider, workplace safety instructor
recognise: Organisations hire them to deliver specific employee training, seminars or workshops.

name: Demo-Led SaaS Sales
examples: small-business CRM, practice management software, customer support platform
recognise: They sell subscription software through conversations, demos, evaluations and pricing discussions.

name: Enterprise Software Procurement
examples: enterprise HR platform, cybersecurity suite, procurement software provider
recognise: They sell complex technology with several decision-makers, technical validation, purchasing approval or contract negotiation.

name: Recruiting / Staffing Placements
examples: recruitment agency, executive search firm, specialist staffing company
recognise: Employers pay them to find and place candidates; they manage hiring assignments through candidate presentation and placement.

name: Real Estate Buyer Transactions
examples: residential buyer's agent, condominium realtor, investment-property broker
recognise: They represent people buying homes or investment properties, through search, offers and closing.

name: Real Estate Seller Transactions
examples: listing agent, residential realtor, property sales broker
recognise: They represent owners selling property and manage listings through offers and completed sales.

name: Commercial Leasing Deals
examples: office leasing broker, retail leasing agent, commercial tenant representative
recognise: They help businesses lease offices, retail space, warehouses or other commercial property.

name: Property Management Contracts
examples: residential property manager, short-term rental manager, commercial property manager
recognise: Owners hire them to handle rentals, tenants, maintenance and day-to-day operations.

name: Mortgage / Loan Applications
examples: residential mortgage broker, commercial loan broker, business financing broker
recognise: They arrange financing through lenders and track applications from qualification to funding.

name: Insurance Policy Sales
examples: life insurance broker, home insurance agent, commercial insurance broker
recognise: They assess insurance needs, compare coverage and help customers buy policies.

name: Financial Advisory Client Acquisition
examples: wealth manager, investment advisor, retirement planner
recognise: They win clients for financial planning, investment management or ongoing advice.

name: Franchise / Licensing Sales
examples: franchise company, business licensor, dealership network
recognise: They recruit people or companies to buy franchises, operating rights, licences or territories.

name: Quoted Repair / Installation Sales
examples: plumbing contractor, auto repair shop, computer repair business
recognise: Customers describe a problem, get an assessment or estimate, and decide whether to authorise the work.

name: Construction / Renovation Contracts
examples: general contractor, kitchen renovation company, commercial remodelling firm
recognise: They sell substantial building or renovation projects with site visits, detailed estimates and formal contracts.

name: Technical Home Installation Sales
examples: solar installer, heat-pump company, home energy systems provider
recognise: They sell expensive installed home systems needing property evaluation, technical design or financing.

name: Recurring Property Service Contracts
examples: commercial cleaning business, landscaping company, pest control provider
recognise: They win customers for recurring cleaning, landscaping, maintenance or treatment services.

name: Personal Service Appointment Sales
examples: hair salon, massage therapist, pet groomer
recognise: They turn customer inquiries into booked individual service appointments.

name: Clinical Treatment Plan Sales
examples: orthodontic clinic, physiotherapy practice, elective dental clinic
recognise: Patients have a consultation or assessment before deciding on a proposed treatment plan.

name: Personal Care Service Contracts
examples: senior home care agency, disability support provider, private caregiving service
recognise: Individuals or families arrange ongoing care after discussing needs and reviewing a care plan.

name: Coaching Package Sales
examples: business coach, life coach, nutrition coach
recognise: They sell structured coaching programmes after an introductory conversation about goals.

name: Fitness Trial-to-Membership Sales
examples: personal training studio, boutique gym, group fitness studio
recognise: They turn prospects into members or training clients after a trial, introductory workout or consultation.

name: Private Lesson Bookings
examples: mathematics tutor, music teacher, language instructor
recognise: They teach individuals through private or small-group lessons and sell recurring lesson packages.

name: Course / Program Enrollment
examples: online course creator, coding bootcamp, vocational training provider
recognise: They sell structured courses, cohorts or training programmes to individual learners.

name: School / Childcare Admissions
examples: private school, preschool, daycare centre
recognise: Families apply for admission, often with tours, applications, acceptance and paperwork.

name: Date-Based Professional Bookings
examples: wedding photographer, event DJ, keynote speaker
recognise: They are hired for a specific service on a particular date, usually with a booking agreement or deposit.

name: Custom Event Service Contracts
examples: wedding planner, event caterer, event decoration company
recognise: They sell customised event services where planning, scope and proposals win the client.

name: Venue / Group Hospitality Bookings
examples: wedding venue, restaurant private-dining room, hotel group-booking service
recognise: Customers reserve venues, private dining, group accommodation or event facilities.

name: Custom Travel Bookings
examples: travel advisor, luxury vacation planner, private tour operator
recognise: They design customised itineraries or tours and guide clients through choosing and booking.

name: Equipment / Item Rental Bookings
examples: event equipment rental, camera rental business, construction equipment rental firm
recognise: They rent equipment or items for set periods and manage availability, pricing and reservations.

name: Conversational Online Product Sales
examples: Instagram boutique, WhatsApp product seller, handmade goods business
recognise: They sell physical products through messages and follow-ups rather than relying only on automated checkout.

name: Consultative Consumer Product Sales
examples: luxury furniture showroom, custom jewellery retailer, premium bicycle shop
recognise: They sell expensive or customised consumer products where buyers need advice, selection or a personal quote.

name: Vehicle Dealership Sales
examples: used car dealership, motorcycle dealer, recreational vehicle dealer
recognise: They sell vehicles through consultations, viewings or test drives, negotiation and purchase agreements.

name: B2B Equipment / Product Sales
examples: industrial machinery supplier, commercial copier dealer, medical equipment seller
recognise: They sell business equipment or products through conversations, specifications, quotes and purchase orders.

name: Wholesale Account Sales
examples: food wholesaler, clothing distributor, beauty-products wholesaler
recognise: They open new accounts with retailers or resellers who buy in bulk.

name: Custom Manufacturing Orders
examples: packaging manufacturer, metal fabrication shop, custom furniture manufacturer
recognise: They make goods to order from customer specifications, designs or drawings.

name: Government Tender / RFP Sales
examples: government IT contractor, public construction bidder, institutional equipment supplier
recognise: They win business through formal tenders, public procurement, institutional bidding or RFPs.

name: Freight / Logistics Bookings
examples: freight broker, shipping agent, third-party logistics provider
recognise: They arrange shipments and win customers through rate quotes and booking confirmations.

name: Major Donor Fundraising
examples: charitable foundation, community charity, educational nonprofit
recognise: They build donor relationships and ask for contributions or pledges.

name: Grant Application Pipeline
examples: arts nonprofit, community development organisation, research foundation
recognise: They seek funding by applying to foundations, governments or other grant-makers.

name: Sponsorship / Brand Partnership Sales
examples: conference organiser, creator sponsorship agency, community sports club
recognise: They sell brand exposure, promotional placements, sponsorship packages or commercial partnerships.

name: Paid Membership Sales
examples: professional association, private business club, paid networking community
recognise: They recruit paying members to organisations, associations, clubs or private communities.
